scope: The same ten Lua-batch artifacts reviewed by x-triage-good, including the three locally relocated attack samples.

summary.retained_warning: Factorio rootfs absolute application-data symlinks cross the extraction root; no additional benign warning was introduced.

readability_and_placement.get_put_literals: Uppercase GET/PUT literals are source-value observations. A GET log label no longer becomes an HTTP request through a directory-wide selector. Direct consumers retain their references under the new IDs.
readability_and_placement.php_append: Generic append-mode file access is consolidated into the existing stream-mode capability. A mode is checked on the actual fopen call, including a constant-bound mode or a root-qualified builtin. Comments and example strings do not establish a file open.
readability_and_placement.xor_names: XOR-related names describe names, not a cipher implementation. The operation finding now requires byte XOR and indexing modulo the same key array length.
readability_and_placement.environment: Lua setfenv is a function-environment API, not an OS environment change or generic language metadata. The new finding describes an API reference and matches the actual API name.
readability_and_placement.generated_commands: Descriptions distinguish generated commands and templates from completed deletion, execution, or encryption. The encoder-prefix fact records passed command text and excludes ordinary print/log calls.
readability_and_placement.inherited_authoring_cleanup: Removed duplicate per-item scopes that already matched their file defaults in crypt_verify and update-rc.d observations from the preceding review.

additional_coverage: MD5 client-IP/User-Agent fingerprinting requires both CGI values in the same hash expression; two separate hashes or two IP reads cannot substitute.
Lua ngx.decode_base64 calls are visible independently of malicious intent.
A Lua shell call that starts the Python HTTP server is distinguished from a quoted or logged command mentioning that server.

BITS command templates accept case changes, the .exe suffix, optional quotes, and varied whitespace. A renamed dispatcher and removal of the unused port parameter do not evade the hostile generator detection.
Lua repeating-key XOR detection survives variable/function renaming and compact formatting. A different divisor array or an inert quoted XOR expression does not establish the same operation.

PHP exploit imports are checked as parsed directives, including parenthesized/double-quoted include or require_once forms. OS comparisons and percent-u construction must be parsed expressions rather than strings documenting code.
Reverse-shell HTML packaging does not require an automatic click. A generated download carrier remains relevant when delivery is manual; automatic clicking is retained as a separate observation.

engine_change.problem: Regex-versus-literal overlap collection discarded call argument predicates, then searched raw patterns for #arg markers that those collectors never populated.
engine_change.fix: Compare serialized argument predicates directly, reusing the existing argument discriminator. Generic API references and mode-filtered calls remain distinct; equivalent argument filters still trigger the overlap check.
engine_change.tests: 105 duplicate-validation tests passed, including generic-versus-filtered, different-filter and equivalent-filter controls.
